plugin.name: Splinter Cell Conviction Fusion Fix
GENERAL.SkipIntro.description: Skips the intro logos and the Press any key screen. Restart required.
DISPLAY.WindowedMode.description: Runs the game in a window instead of fullscreen. Restart required.
GAMEPLAY.DisableNegativeMouseAcceleratio: Removes negative mouse acceleration. Restart required.
GENERAL.SkipSystemDetection.description: Skips redundant hardware detection pop-up box. Restart required.
GENERAL.ForceCPUAffinityToAllCores.descr: Forces the CPU to use all cores, improving performance on some systems. Restart required.
DISPLAY.UltraWideSupport.description: Corrects the HUD and FOV for ultrawide and other non 16:9 aspect ratios. Restart required.
GRAPHICS.DisableBlackAndWhiteFilter.desc: Disables the desaturated black and white look used in shadows. Restart required.
GAMEPLAY.BlacklistControlScheme.descript: Blacklist-style controls (toggle cover, hold to aim, etc). Restart required.
UNLOCKS.UnlockDLC.description: Unlocks all DLC content that can no longer be obtained due to server shutdown. Restart required.
2INSTANCESPLITSCREEN.Enable.description: Split screen co-op on one PC: launches a second instance of the game, each one in half of the screen, connect them over LAN (Create in one, join in the other). Forces windowed mode, the resolution is set automatically. Restart required.
DISPLAY.FPSLimit.description: Frame rate limit (30-1000), 0 = the games own (120 by default). Co-op uses SyncMaxStepFrequency in update\convictionsettings.ini. Restart required.
LOGITECH.LightSyncRGB.description: Dims mouse and keyboard lighting in darkness (and vice versa with BlacklistIndicators). Only Logitech hardware is supported. Requires the Logitech G HUB app. Restart required.
FILELOADER.DumpPackedFiles.description: Dumps the contents of all .umd archives into an 'unpacked' folder next to the exe (see _dump.log in it), rename it to 'update' to load the files from disk instead of the archives. Restart required.
LAN.LANHelperExePath.description: Changes this startup setting. Restart required.
LAN.FixLAN.description: Makes LAN play work: answers the matchmaking config request locally, sends LAN messages on every network adapter and connects to the host by the address its lobby came from. Restart required.
LAN.ServerAddr.description: Where the matchmaking config is requested from, 127.0.0.1 is answered by the game itself. Restart required.
GRAPHICS.DisableDOF.description: Disables the depth of field blur. Restart required.
GRAPHICS.DisableCharacterLighting.descri: Disables Predator Vision, making enemies blend better with the environment. Also affects characters in in-engine cutscenes. Restart required.
GRAPHICS.BlacklistIndicators.description: Enables bloom only in darkness. Restart required.
GAMEPLAY.RawMouseInput.description: Uses raw mouse input for mouse look: no lost movement with high polling rate mice. Restart required.
MAIN.MouseSmoothing.description: Averages mouse movement over four frames. Off gives a direct response. Restart required.
MAIN.GamepadCameraSpeed.description: Gamepad camera speed multiplier; 0 or 1 uses native speed. Changes apply immediately.
2INSTANCESPLITSCREEN.Layout.description: 0 = top and bottom, 1 = left and right. Restart required.
2INSTANCESPLITSCREEN.GamepadInstance1.de: Gamepad of the first window, top or left (1-4, 0 = none). Keyboard and mouse control the focused window. Restart required.
2INSTANCESPLITSCREEN.GamepadInstance2.de: Gamepad of the second window, bottom or right (1-4, 0 = none). Restart required.
2INSTANCESPLITSCREEN.ProfileInstance2.de: Profile of the second window (created if missing), the first one uses the usual profile. Restart required.
SPLITSCREEN.Enable.description: Restores the original split screen co-op in one game window: Co-op -> Split Screen. Player 2 needs a gamepad. Restart required.
SPLITSCREEN.GamepadPlayer1.description: Gamepad of player 1 (1-4, 0 = keyboard and mouse only). Restart required.
SPLITSCREEN.InvertYPlayer2.description: Inverts the look Y axis of player 2 (the games option is player 1). Restart required.
SPLITSCREEN.ProfilePlayer2.description: Profile of player 2 (created if missing), for its own uniform and loadout. Restart required.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language tag for Advanced Options and other plugins. auto follows the game language. Edit in the hub or CFG, then reopen Advanced Options.
menu.title: Advanced Options
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a centered window, or borderless covering the monitor. Takes effect when the game starts. Alt+Enter switches fullscreen and the chosen window style.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the normal gameplay camera field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Scripted, aiming and gadget cameras keep their own framing.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restore this plugin's settings. Press twice to confirm.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset and press twice to apply it to this plugin.
